research_contract: Startup is fully informed from the artifact. Main Lines are read last.

After choosing a route, use changes() only as a compact freshness check: compare the chosen Main Line and Research Line versions against MANIFEST.json. If a chosen line version differs, fetch only that line with read([id]).
Mathematical update content is not delivered through changes(); Research Lines and Main Lines are the mathematical synchronization surfaces.
During mathematical research, workers self-police the no-consultation rule and keep intermediate reasoning local.
Publish only after substantial progress, as one coherent staged batch.
review_staged_batch() is a required concurrency barrier and commit_staged_batch() refuses if another session publishes after review.
usage: Call through the active project schema.
